preregistration.expectation: The pinned llama.cpp b11057 CUDA 13.3 server will serve --parallel 4 concurrent requests across several fixtures on this host's GPU with a locally available small GGUF, fail in-flight requests when killed with SIGKILL mid-load, and recover within tens of seconds after restart.
preregistration.criteria: Record per-phase success rates (concurrent phase, kill phase, post-restart phase), time from restart to first /health 200 and first successful completion. The originally qualified Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M route model is not on this host (19 GB download not attempted), so this can at best advance the gap; host portability (a second host) is not reachable here.
preregistration.late_note: The original gap-8 preregistration planned a small local GGUF; the revised plan using the frozen route model was preregistered at 03:18:03Z (commit 741ecab) before llama_load.py ran.

followup.label: revised preregistration, written after the runtime/model downloads and before llama_load.py ran; supersedes the small-GGUF plan in gaps.8
followup.expectation: With the actual frozen route (b11057 CUDA 13.3 llama-server sha256 7740775d..., Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M sha256 c600de03..., 32 GPU layers) and --parallel 4 --ctx-size 8192, 12 concurrent requests over 4 fixtures (8 client threads) all succeed but slowly (single-stream generation was about 2.2 tok/s on the original host); SIGKILL 8 s into an 8-request batch fails every in-flight request; restart reaches /health 200 in under 30 s (model pages cached) and the 8 post-restart requests all succeed.
followup.criteria: Report success rate per phase, wall time, cold-start and restart-to-healthy seconds, kill-to-first-success seconds, GPU memory min free / max used, memory-guard events. Any post-restart failure counts against recovery. Host portability is not testable here beyond recording this host's GPU (reported RTX 5090 Laptop, 24 GB) versus the RTX4090 in the original receipt.

SIGKILL 8 s into an 8-request batch failed all 8 in-flight requests with RemoteDisconnected; after restart the server was healthy in 5.3 s, served its first request 10.7 s after the kill and completed 8/8. Remaining: one kill/restart trial only; no client-side retry for in-flight requests; answer quality was not rechecked (max_tokens 32); host portability beyond this one host (GPU reported as RTX 5090 Laptop, 24 GB, driver 610.47, versus the RTX4090 in the original receipt) is untested.
limits: Profile differs from the frozen plan only in --parallel 4 and --ctx-size 8192; outputs were capped at 32 tokens, so this measures serving, not quality.
Shared GPU (about 5 GB already used by another process); latencies are shared-host observations, not a benchmark.
